All source identities denote User entities; role sets may overlap without implicit exclusivity.
All timestamps read by predicates are bounded inclusively to 2000-01-01 through 2100-01-01 UTC; requests outside the explicit domain gate deny.

Business revision v2: catalogs are declared synthetic organizational policies, not empirical norms. Selected-atom obligations are mandatory in both forms and cannot be waived by a base exception or override.
Money is nonnegative integer USD cents, at most 1,000,000,000. Counts are nonnegative integers at most 1,000,000 unless a narrower dictionary is declared.
Request context is treated as trusted input from the host; authorization does not attest network, emergency, signature, or scheduling facts.

Retained source repairs: exact lifecycle states, linked course roster, explicit promotion/filing facts, independent calibration expiry, comp expiry, and guarded override eligibility are intentional experiment definitions. Their typed ASTs and field descriptions, not the ambiguous source shorthand, are authoritative.
Rules operate on snapshots. A selected lifecycle base requires the exact named state unless its predicate explicitly lists alternatives.
Source business descriptions are retained for audit; the authored typed predicates and dictionaries define the experiment. No statutory compliance claim is made.
Source tag kinds are represented by Set<String>. Group membership is reflexive and transitive Cedar entity ancestry.
